newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB to introduce new All in One Super.
newsitem.headline: NAB to introduce new All in One Super.

text.p: National Australia Bank said it will be replacing many of its superannuation products with the launch of a new 'All in One' product for personal and business customers on Tuesday.
The new product would simplify superannuation and remove much of the paperwork for customers, said NAB's Chief General Manager, Frank Cicutto.
"All in One Super also lowers superannuation costs because it can remove the need to switch between products, which means no switching fees for customers," he said.
"The launch of All in One Super is a further step in establishing the National as a leading provider of financial services," Cicutto said.
National All in One Super replaces National FlexiSuper Plus, National Rollover Bond, Term Deposit Rollover Bond and National Personal Super Bond.
All in One Super customers can choose from a wide range of investment portfolios, covering all the major asset classes and balanced funds.
Investment portfolios are managed by National Australia Asset Management, but customers can also choose a balanced portfolio with a range of fund managers.
